a marvelous opportunity: Studying abroad for a year is a marvelous opportunity to learn a new language and make friends from many countries.
出國留學一年是學習新語言、結交各國朋友的絕佳的機會。
marvelous weather: What marvelous weather we're having! It's sunny and warm, perfect for a picnic at the beach.
真是好極了的天氣！陽光普照又溫暖，最適合去海邊野餐。
do a marvelous job: The volunteers did a marvelous job of cleaning the park; there wasn't a single piece of trash left.
志工們把公園打掃得非常出色，一片垃圾都沒留下。
masculine pride: His masculine pride would not let him ask for directions, so we drove around lost for an hour.
他男性的自尊讓他不肯開口問路，結果我們迷路開了一個小時。
a masculine voice: The cartoon cat had a deep, masculine voice that made the children laugh because it sounded like their father.
那隻卡通貓有低沉、男性化的聲音，聽起來像孩子們的爸爸，逗得他們哈哈大笑。
masculine nouns: In French, masculine nouns usually take the article le, while feminine nouns take la.
在法語中，陽性名詞通常搭配冠詞 le，而陰性名詞則搭配 la。
a massive increase: The heat wave led to a massive increase in electricity use, as everyone turned on their air conditioners at once.
熱浪導致用電量大幅增加，因為大家同時打開了冷氣。
massive debts: After his business failed, he was left with massive debts of over ten million dollars that he could never repay.
生意失敗後，他背負了超過一千萬元、永遠還不清的巨額債務。
a massive heart attack: The famous actor died suddenly of a massive heart attack while jogging in the park last week.
那位知名演員上週在公園慢跑時，因嚴重的心臟病發作猝逝。
massive support: The plan to build a new library received massive support, with over fifty thousand residents signing the petition.
興建新圖書館的計畫獲得了廣泛的支持，超過五萬名居民在請願書上簽名。
on a massive scale: The factory produces phones on a massive scale, making millions of them every month for markets around the world.
這家工廠大規模地生產手機，每月製造數百萬支銷往世界各地。
mathematical precision: The architect planned every line of the building with mathematical precision, so not even one brick was out of place.
建築師以數學般的精確規劃大樓的每條線，連一塊磚都沒放錯位置。
a mathematical model: Scientists use a mathematical model full of equations to predict how fast the virus will spread.
科學家使用充滿方程式的數學模型來預測病毒傳播的速度。
a mathematical certainty: If you never study and skip every class, failing the course is almost a mathematical certainty.
如果你從不讀書又每堂課都蹺，這門課被當幾乎是絕對確定的事。
the maximum speed: On this highway, the maximum speed is 110 kilometers per hour, and drivers who go faster will be fined.
這條高速公路的最高速度是每小時110公里，開得更快的駕駛會被罰款。
to the maximum: My brother turned the volume up to the maximum, and the whole house shook with the loud music.
我弟弟最大限度地把音量開到最大，整間房子都隨著響亮的音樂震動。
a maximum of ten people: The elevator can carry a maximum of ten people, so the rest of us had to wait for the next one.
這部電梯最多十人，所以我們其他人只好等下一班。
maximum security prison: The dangerous criminal was sent to a maximum security prison with high walls, guards, and cameras everywhere.
那名危險罪犯被送進一座高牆環繞、到處都有警衛和攝影機的最高戒備監獄。
achieve maximum effect: To achieve maximum effect, the speaker used every tool she had, including pictures, videos, and moving personal stories.
為了達到最大效果，講者用上了她所有的工具，包括圖片、影片和感人的親身故事。
a meaningful relationship: After years of short dates, she finally wanted a meaningful relationship built on trust, respect, and shared goals.
經過多年短暫的約會後，她終於想要一段建立在信任、尊重和共同目標上的有意義的關係。
a meaningful look: When the teacher asked who broke the window, Tom gave me a meaningful look, as if to say, "Don't tell her."
老師問是誰打破窗戶時，湯姆給了我一個意味深長的目光，好像在說「別告訴她」。
meaningful dialogue: The two sides finally sat down for meaningful dialogue and reached an agreement that ended the long strike.
雙方終於坐下來進行有意義的對話，並達成結束長期罷工的協議。
a meaningful change: The new program made a meaningful change in the students' lives, not just a small symbolic one on paper.
新計畫在學生的生活中帶來實質的改變，而不只是紙上一點象徵性的變化。
a measurable improvement: After three months of extra practice, there was a measurable improvement in his test scores, which rose by twenty points.
經過三個月的額外練習，他的考試成績有了可量化的改善，提高了二十分。
measurable results: The boss wants measurable results, such as higher sales numbers, not just promises that things will get better.
老闆要的是可衡量的成果，像是更高的銷售數字，而不只是會變好的承諾。
have a measurable effect: Even one hour of exercise a week can have a measurable effect on your blood pressure, according to the study.
根據研究，即使每週只運動一小時，也能對血壓產生可觀的效果。
a mechanical response: When I asked how his day was, he gave a mechanical response, saying "fine" like a robot without looking up.
我問他今天過得如何，他頭也不抬，像機器人一樣說「還好」，給了個機械式的反應。
mechanical failure: The plane had to land early because of a mechanical failure in one of its engines.
這架飛機因為其中一具引擎發生機械故障而必須提早降落。
in a mechanical way: Tired after the long shift, the cashier greeted every customer in a mechanical way, repeating the same words without a smile.
長時間輪班後疲憊不堪，收銀員機械式地招呼每位客人，不帶笑容地重複同樣的話。
mechanical engineering: My cousin studied mechanical engineering because he loves designing machines, engines, and robots.
我表哥念機械工程，因為他熱愛設計機器、引擎和機器人。
